Hi [Recipient's Name],

Would you be available for a 30-minute meeting on [Proposed Date and Time]? If not, I can suggest a few alternative times. Please let me know what works best for you.

Thank you for your time and consideration.

Best regards,

[Your Name]
[Your Position] [Your Company]
